Frequently Asked Questions

WHAT CAN I GROW?

Anything! Fruit, vegetables, flowers and fruit trees.

CAN I HAVE BARBECUES?

Definitely yes!

IS THERE A TENANCY AGREEMENT?

Yes, there is a simple agreement to sign.

TOILETS?

Most allotments have no facilities. We're exploring composting solutions.

ARE THERE RULES?

Yes. Restrictions on bonfires, cockerels, hoses. See Agreement for details.

RAISED BEDS?

Yes, for easier access.

FENCING?

You can fence your plot with chicken wire.

CHILDREN?

Welcome on the site!

RUBBISH?

Take it home. Only compostable waste on site.
